question: A renewal team reviews a cracked trunk sewer before selecting a repair method. Which set of inputs most directly supports choosing lining over open cut replacement?
correctAnswer: Pipe condition, host pipe shape, access points, and service connections
explanation: Lining suitability depends on host pipe condition and shape, available access, and how service connections will be reinstated.

Pipe condition, host pipe shape, access points, and service connections
Pipe length alone, office location, vehicle colour, and meeting schedule
Pipe material alone, staff seniority, fuel price, and holiday scheduling

optionB: Pipe condition, host pipe shape, access points, and service connections
optionC: Pipe length alone, office location, vehicle colour, and meeting schedule
optionD: Pipe material alone, staff seniority, fuel price, and holiday scheduling
